title: Fourier Coefficient Decay Under Hölder Continuity

problemStatement.formal: If f : C(AddCircle T, ℂ) has ‖fourierCoeff f n‖ ≤ C/|n|^β for n ≠ 0 with β > α+1, then ∃ C_holder, HolderWith C_holder α f
problemStatement.plain: Prove the partial converse: if Fourier coefficients decay as O(1/|n|^β) with β > α+1, then f is α-Hölder continuous.
whyMatters: Resolves the sorry at line 403 of FourierSeriesOQ02.lean
Key result in harmonic analysis connecting spectral decay to spatial regularity
